name: valid_knowledge_agent
description: Agent with knowledge store, recall expression, and learn statements parses successfully
input:
use
  llm.reason

agent learner
  memory
    count: Number
  knowledge store: ".forge-knowledge/learner"
    max_entries: 5000
    retention: 90d

  on query(question: Text)
    prior = recall "{question}"
    when prior.sure -> give prior
    else -> escalate to human

  on train(fact: Text)
    learn "{fact}"
    say "Learned: {fact}"

  on ingest(path: Text)
    learn from document(path)
    say "Ingested"

  on record(q: Text, a: Text)
    learn from interaction(q, a, 0.9)
    say "Recorded"
